narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On January 16, 2024, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a bus station in Kalamazoo, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no immigration documents.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he crossed on foot through the desert west of Columbus, New Mexico, on or about 09/03/2022, and was picked up by a driver on a ranch road the next morning.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
